f_ir.name: loss_logsigmoid_001_scale085
f_ir.intuition: This is a pairwise -logsigmoid loss on the log-prob gap (lpw-lpl) with a temperature-like scale. The parent has invalid metrics (pair_count=0, objective=Infinity), which often happens when the margin signal is too sharp/unstable early and leads to unusable pairs or exploding gradients. I reduce `scale` to soften the logits entering logsigmoid (still clamped to [-20,20]) so gradients are less saturated and more stable across a wider range of (lpw-lpl) magnitudes, improving optimization and reducing the risk of numerical/pathological behavior while keeping the same functional form.

loss_ir.intuition: This is a pairwise -logsigmoid loss on the log-prob gap (lpw-lpl) with a temperature-like scale. I reduce `scale` to soften the logits entering logsigmoid (still clamped to [-20,20]) so gradients are less saturated and more stable across a wider range of (lpw-lpl) magnitudes, improving optimization and reducing the risk of numerical/pathological behavior while keeping the same functional form.
